translations.web: You shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin. It will be a token of the covenant between me and you.
translations.bsb: You are to circumcise the flesh of your foreskin, and this will be a sign of the covenant between Me and you.
translations.kjv: And ye shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of the covenant
translations.asv: And ye shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of a covenant betwixt me and you.
